description.value: The Lillooet R.E.C. Centre (Recreation, Education, and Cultural Centre) is a regional civic facility operated by the Squamish-Lillooet Regional District on Main Street in Lillooet. It combines recreation, library, and cultural services under one roof, making it a community hub in this small Interior BC town that sits at the junction of several long-distance cycling routes. For touring cyclists passing through Lillooet, it represents a logical stop in a community with limited services.
